contract.storage: independent existing SelectionData values: Boolean/affine/geometric/native fractional RLE

nativeWorkingBudgets.note: One extreme-width scanline may exceed the band budget. Source decoding, compressed blobs, RLE, validation and document/history storage consume additional memory; no heap peak was measured.

performanceNotes: The initial geometry-only case took 13.45 seconds before provably disjoint region culling. Later fixtures also retain a real native PNG source and verify project restoration. These individual container observations are not a controlled same-fixture comparison, gesture percentiles or cross-device speed claims. Exact unsimplified-WASM comparisons cover affine holes and intersections followed by additions across native tile boundaries.
regressionFindings: Whole Boolean expressions must be rasterized before channel composition. Alpha add/intersect use the existing max/min rules; subtract preserves fractional multiplication.
Corrected Color Range proxy add/intersect math to match its committed max/min masks; empty native matches now combine without throwing.

The 52-case development run passed 51 and exposed an idle crop Escape overlay bug. Crop bounds/active state lived outside the retained ToolState comparison; invalidating its UI snapshot before crop publication fixes it. All four crop cases plus all seven alpha cases pass after the fix.
Initial alpha UI locators omitted the count badge and Document command category from accessible names. Corrected the locators; the palette save and full UI management case passes.
An overlapping Playwright invocation removed a shared trace output directory. Reproduced the crop failure with a separate trace directory; final invocations use distinct output directories.
limits: RGB/CMYK component editing, spot colors and PSD alpha-channel interchange remain unimplemented.
Current refinement loads into ordinary selection tools and updates the channel; direct grayscale channel painting is not implemented.
Loaded coverage records for offline recipes. Channel-management recipe steps report unsupported explicitly.
Very dense RLE, command/request complexity, extreme row widths and actual browser/process memory remain limits; no image megapixel cutoff was added.
Quick selection, broader F02 fidelity/device gates and the remainder of the full roadmap remain active and unfinished.
